description: Adds the email settings SenderFix found missing: the domain's approved senders list (merged with any existing one) and a DMARC record that protects the domain and sends daily reports to SenderFix.
variableDescription: spfrules: SPF mechanisms for the customer's email provider, without the leading 'v=spf1' or trailing 'all', e.g. 'include:spf.protection.outlook.com'. dmarcrules: the DMARC tags after the version, e.g. 'p=none; rua=mailto:abc123@senderfixreports.com'.
